## How to add a paper

1. Add the BibTeX entry to `papers/references.bib` with a citekey of
   the form `lastnameYEARword` (lowercase, no punctuation).
2. Create `papers/notes/<citekey>.md` from the schema template.
3. Fill in the structured summary sections.
4. Open a pull request — CI will validate the front-matter.
